newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks sink as buy-back momentum eases.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks sink as buy-back momentum eases.

text.p: Tokyo stocks sank on Monday as the momentum of buy-backs of bank and construction shares eased late in the session, eroding earlier gains, brokers said.
Profit-taking sales of blue-chip issues, which had appreciated in recent months, added to the losses, they said.
The Nikkei average of 225 leading shares ended at 18,896.99, down 137.55 points or 0.72 percent. Its March futures slipped 170 points to close at 18,860.
"Buy-backs of bank and construction shares took a breather, which made the market falter," said Harushige Kobayashi, Yamaichi Securities deputy general manager.
